Item.description: Displays a report about all core public methods used in Innovator server methods
Item.xsl_stylesheet:
function WriteDllInfo(DllNodeList) { var dllNode = DllNodeList.nextNode(); var nodelist = dllNode.childNodes; var res= "<table width=\"700\">"; res += "<tr><th class=\"itHeader\">Assembly Information</th></tr>" res += "<tr><td class=\"itInfo\">" for (var j=0; j<nodelist.length; j++) { var objNode = nodelist.nextNode(); res += objNode.text + "<br>"; } res+="</td></tr></table>"; return res; } function GetMethodInf(methodNode,signatureArr,countArr,dllArr,typeArr,count) { var nodelist = methodNode.selectNodes("callMethod"); for (var i=0; i<nodelist.length; i++) { var objNode = nodelist.nextNode(); oNamedNodeMap = objNode.attributes; var callMethodName = oNamedNodeMap.getNamedItem("Name").text; var type = oNamedNodeMap.getNamedItem("type").text; var dllName = oNamedNodeMap.getNamedItem("dll").text; if (countArr[callMethodName] == undefined) { countArr[callMethodName] = 1; signatureArr[count] = callMethodName ; dllArr[count] = dllName; typeArr[count] = type; count++; } else countArr[callMethodName]++; } return count; } function WriteMethodInf(signatureArr,countArr,dllArr,typeArr,count) { var res = "<tr><td class=\"istHeader\">" + "IOM.dll" + "</td></tr>"; for (var i=0; i<count; i++) { if (dllArr[i] == "IOM.dll") res += "<tr><td class=\"istCell\" onmouseover=\"className='istCellHvr'\" onmouseout=\"className='istCell'\">" + "<div class=\"istNumSpan\">" + countArr[signatureArr[i]] + "</div>" + typeArr[i] + "." + signatureArr[i] + "</td></tr>"; } res += "<tr><td class=\"istHeader\">" + "Aras.Server.Core.dll" + "</td></tr>"; for (var i=0; i<count; i++) { if (dllArr[i] == "Aras.Server.Core.dll") res += "<tr><td class=\"istCell\" onmouseover=\"className='istCellHvr'\" onmouseout=\"className='istCell'\">" + "<div class=\"istNumSpan\">" + countArr[signatureArr[i]] + "</div>" + typeArr[i] + "." + signatureArr[i] + "</td></tr>"; } res += "<tr><td class=\"istHeader\">" + "Late binding calls" + "</td></tr>"; for (var i=0; i<count; i++) { if (dllArr[i] == "") res += "<tr><td class=\"istCell\" onmouseover=\"className='istCellHvr'\" onmouseout=\"className='istCell'\">" + "<div class=\"istNumSpan\">" + countArr[signatureArr[i]] + "</div>" + signatureArr[i] + "</td></tr>"; } return res; } function WriteReportByMethod(methodNodeList) { var signatureArr = new Array(); var countArr = new Array(); var dllArr = new Array(); var typeArr = new Array(); var count = 0; var oNamedNodeMap; var methodNode = methodNodeList.nextNode(); oNamedNodeMap = methodNode.attributes; var innMethodName = oNamedNodeMap[0].text; var compiled = oNamedNodeMap[1].text; var errMsg = (oNamedNodeMap[2] ? oNamedNodeMap[2].text : ""); if (compiled == "false" || errMsg != "") { var res="<td style=\"color:Red\" class=\"itCell1\">" + innMethodName + "</td>"; res += "<td style=\"color:Red\" class=\"istHeader\">" + (errMsg ? errMsg : "Compilation Error") + "</td>" return res; } count = GetMethodInf(methodNode,signatureArr,countArr,dllArr,typeArr,count); var res="<td class=\"itCell1\">" + innMethodName + "</td>"; res += "<td class=\"itCell2\">" + "<table width=\"100%\" cellspacing=\"0\" border=\"0\">"; res += WriteMethodInf(signatureArr,countArr,dllArr,typeArr,count); res+="</table>" + "</td>"; return res; } function WriteReport(reportNodeList) { var res=""; var signatureArr = new Array(); var countArr = new Array(); var typeArr = new Array(); var dllArr = new Array(); var count = 0; var rootNode = reportNodeList.nextNode(); var methodNodeList = rootNode.selectNodes("method"); for (var j=1; j<methodNodeList.length; j++) { var methodNode = methodNodeList.nextNode(); count = GetMethodInf(methodNode,signatureArr,countArr,dllArr,typeArr,count); } res += WriteMethodInf(signatureArr,countArr,dllArr,typeArr,count); return res; }
NOTE
The Method Summary report requires the .NET SDK to be installed on the Server.
Information gathered about late binding calls can be inaccurate
